jd:
About the job

Job Description

About the Role:

We’re looking for scrappy self-starter backend developers familiar with high throughput distributed

systems. You’ll be part of the team that hardens our core order management engine, optimizes TPS,

develops new features, expands to new asset classes, and builds core trading strategies vis-à-vis retail

order flow. You will work closely with the founders and be a key part of the technical leadership team.

Qualifications

A firefighter with a few burns and scars, but not burnt out! ️ 🔥
Expertise building real-time high-throughput systems at 99.9%+ uptime SLA
Golang experience (or Rust or Python & C++ if no direct Golang experience)
Experience building async queuing systems, batch processing, pub-sub architecture, websockets,

etc.

Database scalability & systems-level performance optimization
Familiarity with infra-as-code, especially in AWS (e.g. configuring with Terraform, docker container

orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, etc.)

Must be able to problem-solve from a “solutions-first” and “product-first” perspective, rather than

“code-first” or “technology-first”

Interest or prior experience in finance (e.g. trading, quant research, banking, brokerage, crypto

exchange, etc.)

Some devops/SRE experience, especially with Terraform + AWS Cloudwatch stack, is a bonus!

Required Skills

['C++', 'Python']

Additional Information

Education: B.Tech from top IITs with CSE branch and 9+ cgpa Qualification Criteria:

Quantitative Developer from top HFTs of India

name: Atlassian
jd:
About the job

Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Responsibilities

Contribute to code reviews, documentation, and complex debugging with a strong focus on security, performance, and reliability. Guide the technical direction and implementation of large-scale product features. Evaluate trade-offs between correctness, robustness, performance, and customer impact to deliver the right solutions. Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering teams to influence product strategy while shipping well-tested, secure, reliable, and maintainable code, responding to real-world product usage, and resolving bugs and production issues. Work with designers to build dynamic user experiences. Support the full engineering stack within a complex system.

40 hrs/week, Mon-Fri, 8:30 a.m. - 5:30 p.m. Salary Range: $221,187 to $235,000/yr.

Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

Please visit go.atlassian.com/payzones for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Qualifications

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

Master's degree or foreign equivalent degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, and three (3) years of related work experience.

In the alternative, the employer will accept Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, and five (5) years of post-bachelor's, progressive related work experience.

Must Have Three (3) Years Of Experience With/in

Debugging, production support, and complex issue resolution
Code reviews, documentation, and quality assurance best practices
Working with JavaScript (ES6), HTML5, and CSS with modern frameworks such as React, AngularJS, or Vue
Server-side development with Java and Node.js using object-oriented design
Testing frameworks and practices such as Jest, Cypress, Mocha, or Chai
A/B testing, data-driven development, and front-end architecture
Building and integrating REST APIs, GraphQL, SQL, and basic data and numerical analysis

Employer will accept any suitable combination of education, training, or experience.

100% Telecommuting permitted.

Please email resume to: postings@atlassian.com and must reference Job code: "CA016" to be considered.”

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits .

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh .

In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

name: Vynca
jd:
Join the dynamic journey at Vynca, where we're passionate about transforming care for individuals with complex needs.

We’re more than just a team; we're a close-knit community. Our shared commitment to caring for each other and those we serve is what sets us apart. Guided by our unwavering core values: Excellence, Compassion, Curiosity, and Integrity, we forge paths of success together. Join us in this transformative movement where you can contribute to making a profound difference every day.

At Vynca, our mission is to provide comprehensive care for more quality days at home.

About the job
We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of experience building production-grade applications across the stack. You will work on our Vynca Clinical solution, collaborating closely with design, product, and engineering teammates to deliver performant, secure, and user-friendly software that improves the delivery of high-touch care.
You’ll own features end-to-end—from backend APIs to frontend UI—and work across a modern stack that includes React, TypeScript, FastAPI, and GraphQL. We are looking for someone excited by clean code, thoughtful design, and a strong sense of ownership in building product-focused software.

This is a hybrid position based in San Mateo, CA, with an expectation of working from the office 2 days per week.

Evergreen Posting 
Vynca hires for this role on an ongoing basis throughout the year. This posting stays open because we regularly have openings for Senior Full Stack Engineers, but we don’t have a fixed start date or hiring timeline. We review applications as positions become available, and not every applicant will be contacted right away. Submitting an application doesn’t guarantee an interview or offer. If your background strongly matches a current or upcoming opening, a member of our team will reach out. Applications may be kept on file for 6 months for future openings.

What you’ll do

Backend (Python + FastAPI)
Design and implement GraphQL and RESTful APIs using FastAPI and Strawberry GraphQL.

Build and maintain backend services to support UI features, authentication flows, and patient/provider workflows.

Model data with SQLAlchemy and manage schema changes with Alembic.

Integrate with third-party APIs (e.g., HealthGorilla, Salesforce, PVerify, Google APIs, Slack).

Write unit and integration tests using Pytest and testcontainers.

Maintain API security, access control, and logging practices.

Event driven architecture, CQRS design patterns, HAPI FHIR Server, Full Text/Fuzzy Search & Semantic Search.

 
Frontend (React + TypeScript)
Build and maintain features in a React + TypeScript codebase using functional components and hooks.

Implement responsive UI components using Material UI (MUI) and Emotion for styling.

Manage client-side state using Redux Toolkit, Formik, and Yup.

Integrate with backend services via GraphQL (Apollo Client) and REST APIs (Axios).

Handle authentication flows with Auth0.

Build protected and dynamic routes with react-router-dom.

Write unit and integration tests using tools like Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright and MSW.

Implement features like file uploads, PDF generation (pdf-lib), digital signature capture, and custom surveys.

Use LaunchDarkly for feature flagging and Vite for builds and local dev.

 
Your experience and qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field (advanced degree preferred).

5+ years of experience in full stack or frontend/backend development roles.

Proficient in React and TypeScript.

Experience integrating GraphQL and REST APIs.

Familiarity with backend frameworks such as FastAPI or similar.

Knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and ORMs like SQLAlchemy.

Comfortable with git, monorepos, and Yarn or similar package managers.

Testing experience on both frontend (Vitest, Testing Library) and backend (Pytest).

Experience working in Agile teams using Jira and Scrum ceremonies.

 
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Strawberry GraphQL or Apollo Server, HAPI FHIR.

Familiarity with Auth0 and OAuth-based authentication.

Experience with document generation or PDF handling (e.g., pdf-lib, fpdf2, survey.js).

Exposure to Slack bots, email validation, or healthcare-specific data models (FHIR, HL7).

Experience with semantic search (e.g. typesense).

Knowledge of building secure systems adhering to law governance standards like HIPPA.

 
Tech Stack You’ll Work With

Frontend:
React 18+, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Apollo Client, Formik, Yup, MUI, Emotion, Axios, Vite, MSW, Testing Library, Vitest, pdf-lib, LaunchDarkly

Backend:
Python 3.11+, FastAPI, Strawberry GraphQL, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, Pydantic v2, Pytest, Auth0, Redis, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Typer, HAPI, Typesense

Dev & Infra:
Docker, GitHub Actions, Poetry, testcontainers, Jira, Scrum

 
Who You Are

● Curious and eager to learn—especially from principal engineers.
● Thoughtful about UX and backend reliability.
● A proactive communicator and collaborator.
● Excited by healthcare complexity and impact.
● Comfortable asking for help and giving/receiving feedback.

Additional Information
The hiring process for this role may consist of applying, followed by a phone screen, online assessment(s), interview(s), an offer, and background/reference checks.

Background Screening: A background check, which may include a drug test or other health screenings depending on the role, will be required prior to employment.

Job Description Scope: This job description is not exhaustive and may include additional activities, duties, and responsibilities not listed herein.

Vaccination Requirement: Employees in patient, client, or customer-facing roles must be vaccinated against influenza. Requests for religious or medical accommodations will be considered but may not always be approved.

Employment Eligibility: Compliance with federal law requires identity and work eligibility verification using E-Verify upon hire.

Equal Opportunity Employer: At Vynca Inc., we embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. We value all applicants regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, or membership in any other protected group under federal, state, or local law.

Environmental Conditions and Physical Requirements: Works with Vynca patients/clients remotely and/or in-person. Successfully performs the essential duties and responsibilities of the position through the use of physical activities as described below:
Regularly requires sitting, standing, walking, talking, use of hands, listening, and observing.

Regularly requires working at a computer for an entire shift (with appropriate breaks).

Regularly requires use of laptop and video-conferencing technology.

Occasionally requires reaching, stooping, bending, kneeling, and lifting items weighing 25 pounds or less.

Occasional travel may be required to perform job duties, attend training, or company events.

name: VibeIQ
jd:
About the job

Position Summary

We're looking for a Sr. Full Stack Engineer to join the Core Apps team. Core Apps builds the products our customers use every day: the collaboration board, the planning grid, and the showcases they share with partners and buyers. We also own the services and shared libraries behind them, covering line planning, item search, assortments, documents, presentations and previews, projects, custom entities, and AI-assisted line and item generation.

This is a true full stack team, and this role leans backend. You'll own API services across the domain, from the data model and service architecture through the AWS infrastructure they run on. You'll also work in the Angular apps that consume those services.

Essential Functions

Design, build, and maintain the backend services behind our core apps.
Run those services on AWS and stay accountable for their reliability, performance, observability, and cost.
Build AI-assisted generation features, such as generating lines and items from customer data, along with the services that support them.
Own features end to end, from technical design through deployment and monitoring, including the Angular work when the feature calls for it.
Model data for large customer catalogs and multi-tenant workloads, and keep it fast as those catalogs grow.
Work with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define what we build, and bring your own ideas to that conversation.
Diagnose and fix production issues across distributed systems.
Improve how we work: code quality, code review, continuous integration, and testing.
Mentor other engineers, lead design reviews, and raise the technical bar on the team.
Collaborate with teams across VibeIQ to improve our product, architecture, and engineering practices.

Required Experience

5+ years building and running production backend services, TypeScript and Node.js preferred.
Hands-on AWS depth across Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, IAM, and event-driven services such as SQS and SNS. You've operated what you built.
A track record of API design and data modeling in reliable, high-traffic systems.
Working proficiency in a modern frontend framework, Angular preferred or React.
Strong debugging skills in distributed systems. You can research a problem, weigh the options, and design a fix that spans the stack.
Clear technical writing: design docs, runbooks, and decisions others can act on without follow-up.
Proactive communication. You care about learning, growing, and helping others do the same.
Startup mentality: comfort with ownership, fast iteration, and wearing multiple hats

NICE TO HAVE

Domain experience in retail, apparel, or consumer products: line planning, assortments, merchandising, or PLM.
Experience shipping LLM-backed product features, including prompt design, evaluation, and cost and latency tradeoffs.
Familiarity with SaaS integrations such as PLM, DAM, PIM, or ERP systems.
Experience with real-time sync, WebSockets, or collaborative editing.
Depth in Angular, NgRx/RxJS, or browser performance work.
Experience with OpenSearch or Elasticsearch at scale.
Experience with automated testing and testable system design.
Experience managing cloud spend.
An interest in security.
A strong intuition for UX.

WHY JOIN US

Transform how companies work by empowering the collaboration behind every great product
Work on challenging, high-impact projects with enterprise clients.
Collaborate with top talent in a dynamic, growth-oriented company.
Enjoy flexibility, autonomy, and opportunities for career advancement.
Be part of a Professional Services team that values innovation, customer success, and continuous learning.

Benefits

401(k), Health, Dental, Vision

12 Paid Holidays per Year

Discretionary Time Off

Paid Parental Leave

About Vibeiq

At VibeIQ, we pioneer the future of digital collaboration with our innovative suite of apps built specifically for product teams. Our mission is helping companies that design, manufacture, or sell products work more effectively, enable a better work-life balance, and reduce their environmental impact.

VibeIQ, Inc. values a diverse team and is an equal opportunity employer.

IMPORTANT NOTICE: We do not use WhatsApp, Telegram, or personal Gmail/Yahoo accounts to recruit or conduct interviews.

FRAUD ALERT: VibeIQ never charges fees at any stage of the recruitment process and will never ask for your banking details or personal financial information.

OUR PROCESS: VibeIQ's interview process always includes live video or in-person conversations with our team. We will never extend a job offer via text message or chat application, or without a formal interview.

Compensation Range: $150K - $200K
